plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre path.char_count() > 0
  post out.split("|").len() == 2
  ex plugin("missing.txt") == "|"
  let mine = fs.read(path) else ""
  let theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
  mine + "|" + theirs

run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre path.char_count() > 0
  post out.split("|").len() == 2
  ex run_plugin("missing.txt") == "|"
  let dir = "notes"
  var result = ""
  with fs = fs.sub(dir)
    result = plugin(path)
  result
